# Third-party implementations

Do not copy large upstream codebases into this directory before review. For each pruning method, record:

- paper title and canonical link;
- official repository URL;
- exact upstream commit;
- license and redistribution constraints;
- models and architectures supported upstream;
- local patches or adaptation decisions;
- validation evidence for each project model.

Planned review order: Magnitude Pruning, Wanda, SparseGPT, then SLEB.
